title: 第3章 一人压全真第4章 石剑无锋大巧不工
lines: 江寒看了一下自己现在的数据面板。
姓名：江寒
年龄：22
实力：顶尖
武学：九阴真经（残）、黯然**掌、玄铁剑法
改命点：10
昔日杨过尚未大成，便可横压全真教。
今日他以顶尖实力，在重阳宫横着走，自然不成问题。
路上江寒有意尝试自己新得的武功，抄起杨过运起轻功，竟直接从山腰如雀鸟入林，一路滑翔到山脚。
这等惊鸿一瞥的轻功，彻底打消了杨过心中的疑虑。
对此次全真教之行充满信心！
江寒刚下山，来到先前杨过被欺负的小亭处，便看到苏醒过来的鹿清笃像是哈巴狗一样，带着自己的师傅赵志敬和一干人等，持剑下山。
“师傅，杨过那个狗杂种不在重阳宫，肯定是跑了。这会儿追肯定来得及！”
鹿清笃满脸焦急，他要抓到杨过，然后狠狠的体罚，方才能解他心头之恨。
赵志敬瞥了一眼鹿清笃，不由白了他一眼，叫骂道：
“你这个废物，不是说了让你只传心法不传武功的吗？怎么还会被那个小子打到昏迷？”
要知道鹿清笃这个死胖子，跟在他身边也有六七年的时间。
自己也算颇为用心的教导。
虽然是中人之姿，但实力在他的弟子中，也排行前列。
今日居然被一个手无缚鸡之力的杨过打败，他这个做师傅的实在面上无光。
一群人像是无头苍蝇一样在小亭附近。
甚至还有弟子无聊拿着剑在灌木和杂草中刺探，仿佛里面藏了个杨过。
行为看上去极其智障。
杨过自然也看到了在全真教最让人咬牙切齿的一帮人，说道：
“师傅，就是这帮人，在全真教里成天整我虐待我的，就是这群人。为首留胡子的，就是我的师……赵志敬那个狗贼！”
江寒淡淡一笑：“那好，就从他们开始好了。”
远处灌木丛里传来一阵窸窣声，立刻吸引了一众全真弟子的注意。
当鹿清笃看到跟在奇装异服的江寒身边的杨过，不禁咬牙切齿道：“小杂种，伤了你道爷还想跑，今天看我怎么收拾你！”
鹿清笃仗着有赵志敬撑腰，直接提剑上前。
江寒随手一掌，直接把鹿清笃掀了个人仰马翻，肥硕的身体连打了好几个滚才止住。
赵志敬和其他弟子纷纷围上来。
赵志敬脸面阴冷，一上来就是一顶大帽子扣上来。
“阁下随意伤我全真教弟子，未免太不把我们全真教放在眼里？”
江寒心道，要是放在眼里我也不会一掌握武功就直接上山门了。
江寒依旧是淡淡语气，道：“恩，带杨过上山，顺便见一下全真掌教，以及几位真人。”
赵志敬见对方竟直接无视他的提问，心中涌起一股无名之火，当即又是一个帽子扣下来：
“阁下伤了我全真弟子，还想上山，是否心存不轨！”
说罢，大喝一声：“结阵！”
天罡北斗阵分大阵和小阵，眼下以赵志敬为阵眼，手下弟子纷纷就位，结成七星北斗阵，径直朝江寒袭来。
“有其师必有其徒。”
若非得留赵志敬一命，等上山和杨过解除师徒关系，江寒不介意现在就一掌废了这个见风使舵、阳奉阴违的家伙。
content_en:
Jiang Han looked at his current data panel.
Name: Jiang Han
Age: 22
Strength: Top
Martial arts: Jiuyin Manual (remaining), Anran** Palm, Black Iron Sword Technique
Change life points: 10
————
In the past, Yang Guo was able to overwhelm the Quanzhen Sect before he became a master.
Today, with his top strength, he was able to walk sideways in the Chongyang Palace, so there was no problem.
On the way, Jiang Han wanted to try out his new martial arts skills. He picked up Yang Guo and started using Qing Kung Fu. He actually went directly from the mountainside into the forest like a bird, gliding all the way to the foot of the mountain.
This stunning glimpse of Qinggong completely dispelled Yang Guo's doubts.
I am confident in this trip to Quanzhen Religion!
As soon as Jiang Han came down the mountain and came to the small pavilion where Yang Guo had been bullied, he saw Lu Qingdu, who had regained consciousness, like a pug, leading his master Zhao Zhijing and a group of people down the mountain with swords.
"Master, that bastard Yang Guo is not in Chongyang Palace. He must have run away. It's definitely too late to chase him now!"
Lu Qingdu's face was filled with anxiety. He had to catch Yang Guo and then severely punish him corporally in order to relieve the hatred in his heart.
Zhao Zhijing glanced at Lu Qingdu, rolled his eyes at him, and yelled:
"You good-for-nothing, didn't I tell you to only teach your mind skills but not your martial arts? How could you still be beaten into coma by that kid?"
You must know that Lu Qingdu, a fat guy, has been with him for six or seven years.
He also taught me quite carefully.
Although he has a middle-aged appearance, his strength ranks among the top among his disciples.
Today, he was actually defeated by Yang Guo, who had no strength to restrain a chicken. As a master, he was really in disgrace.
A group of people were like headless flies near the booth.
There are even disciples who are boring into bushes and weeds with their swords, as if there is a poplar hidden in them.
The behavior seems extremely retarded.
Yang Guo naturally also saw the most enviable group of people in the Quanzhen Sect and said:
"Master, this is the group of people who have been teasing me and abusing me all day long in the Quanzhen Sect. The leader with the beard is my master...that thief Zhao Zhijing!"
Jiang Han smiled faintly: "Well, let's start with them."
A rustling sound came from the bushes in the distance, which immediately attracted the attention of all Quanzhen disciples.
When Lu Qingdu saw Yang Guo following Jiang Han in strange clothes, he couldn't help but gritted his teeth and said, "You little bastard, I hurt your Taoist master and you still want to run away. Let's see how I deal with you today!"
Lu Qingdu relied on Zhao Zhijing's support and stepped forward with his sword.
With a casual palm, Jiang Han knocked Lu Qingdu off his back, rolling his fat body several times before he stopped.
Zhao Zhijing and other disciples gathered around him one after another.
Zhao Zhijing's face was grim, and he put on a big hat as soon as he came up.
"Your Excellency hurts my disciples of the Quanzhen Sect at will. Doesn't it mean that you don't take our Quanzhen Sect too seriously?"
Jiang Han thought to himself, if you take it seriously, I won't go directly to the mountain gate as soon as I master the martial arts.
Jiang Han still said in a calm tone: "Well, let's take Yang Guo up the mountain and meet Master Quanzhen and a few real people by the way."
When Zhao Zhijing saw that the other party actually ignored his question, an unknown fire surged in his heart, and he immediately put another hat on his head:
"Your Excellency hurt my Quanzhen disciple and still wants to go up the mountain. Do you have evil intentions?"
After that, he shouted: "Form up!"
The Tiangang Beidou Formation is divided into a large formation and a small formation. With Zhao Zhijing as the formation's eye, his disciples took their positions one after another, forming a seven-star Beidou Formation and heading straight towards Jiang Han.
“For every teacher, there must be a disciple.”
If Zhao Zhijing had to be spared, Jiang Han wouldn't mind killing this guy who acted according to the circumstances and acted against the will with one blow right now when he went up the mountain to terminate the master-disciple relationship with Yang Guo.
title_en: Chapter 3: One person defeats the whole truth Chapter 4: The stone sword has no sharp edge but no skill
